extra.message: The /contact route parses `req.url` query parameter `url` and passes it unvalidated to needle.get(query.url, ...), letting an attacker force the server to make arbitrary outbound HTTP(S) requests (e.g. to internal metadata endpoints, internal services, or localhost), and reflects the response/redirects to the attacker.

JWT verification uses a hardcoded secret string 'hardsecret'. Anyone who reads the source (or guesses this weak, checked-in secret) can forge valid auth tokens for any user ID, completely bypassing authentication. Same literal secret is used to sign tokens in src/models/user.js line 71.

jwt.sign uses the hardcoded secret 'hardsecret' to issue auth tokens. Combined with the same hardcoded secret used for verification in src/middleware/auth.js, an attacker who obtains this value (e.g. from source control) can mint valid session tokens for any user.

PATCH /api/v1/tasks/:id requires auth but fetches the task with Task.findById(req.params.id) instead of scoping by owner (unlike the v2 route which uses {_id, owner: req.user._id}). Any authenticated user can supply another user's task ID and modify its description/completed fields.
